user.title: WebSocket Bridge
user.description: A generic bridge that creates entities declared by any WebSocket client (such as a gateway app). No extra config needed here. Enter this HA's URL and a long-lived access token in the client.

init.title: WebSocket Bridge options
init.description: Select which users are allowed to own gateway tokens. Gateway clients must connect with a long-lived access token created by one of these users.

data.allowed_user_ids: Users allowed to own gateway tokens
